propositions: Project-supplied code-review criteria's applies_to field is stored but never validated at load or read during dispatch, causing criteria to run on every review regardless of changed files
applies_to lacks shape validation in _validate_routing_entry, so malformed values (non-list, non-string elements, bare strings) silently narrow to empty list instead of failing loudly
Project criteria are dispatched after applying gate-YAML when: expressions, structurally sidestepping file-based gating that built-in criteria respect
Globs for project criteria must resolve from effective_routing(repo_root) and be matched against the same changed_files list the triggers step uses, not the packaged routing_index

applies_to has opposite semantic meanings for built-in overlays (empty means escalation-only, never glob-fires) versus project criteria (empty means ungated, always runs), creating silent collision risk
